title: Show open time slots
signature: def open_slots(store: Store, day: date, tz: str) -> list[Slot]
spec: Return the slots whose start time falls on the given calendar day in the given IANA timezone (e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles'). Exclude slots that have a booking with status 'booked'; slots whose only bookings are 'cancelled' are open again. Sort by start time, earliest first.

title: Book a slot
signature: def book(store: Store, customer_id: int, pet_id: int, slot_id: int, now: datetime) -> Booking
spec: Create a Booking with status 'booked', add it to store.bookings using store.next_booking_id(), and return it. Raise BookingError (from store) if: the slot does not exist; the pet does not exist or does not belong to the customer; the slot already has a 'booked' booking (cancelled ones don't count); or the slot starts at or before `now`.

title: Cancel a booking
signature: def cancel(store: Store, booking_id: int, by_customer_id: int, now: datetime) -> Booking
spec: Set the booking's status to 'cancelled' and return it. Raise BookingError if: the booking does not exist; it belongs to a different customer; it is already cancelled; or the slot starts less than 2 hours after `now` (exactly 2 hours is allowed).

title: Reschedule a booking
signature: def reschedule(store: Store, booking_id: int, new_slot_id: int, by_customer_id: int, now: datetime) -> Booking
spec: Move an existing 'booked' booking to a different slot by updating its slot_id (keep the same booking id) and return it. Raise BookingError if: the booking does not exist, is cancelled, or belongs to someone else; the new slot does not exist, starts at or before `now`, or already has a 'booked' booking by someone else. Rescheduling to the slot it is already in is an error too. The old slot becomes free automatically because the booking no longer points to it.

title: Find reminders to send
signature: def reminders_due(store: Store, now: datetime) -> list[Booking]
spec: Return 'booked' bookings whose slot starts more than 23 hours and at most 25 hours after `now` (a reminder window around 24 hours before). `now` and slot times are timezone-aware; compare correctly even if `now` is given in a non-UTC timezone. Sort by slot start time.

title: Calculate the deposit
spec: The deposit is 2000 cents ($20). If the service costs less than $20, the deposit is the full price. Free services have no deposit. Raise ValueError for a negative price.

title: Clean up signup details
signature:
def normalize_email(raw: str) -> str
def normalize_phone(raw: str) -> str
spec: normalize_email: trim spaces and lowercase; raise ValueError unless it has exactly one '@', a non-empty name part, and a domain containing a dot that doesn't start or end with a dot. normalize_phone: accept US numbers in common formats like '(415) 555-0132', '415.555.0132', '415 555 0132', '+1 415-555-0132', '1-415-555-0132' and return E.164 form '+14155550132'. Raise ValueError for anything that isn't exactly 10 digits, or 11 digits starting with 1, after removing formatting characters (spaces, dashes, dots, parentheses, a leading +). Letters are always invalid.

title: Staff daily schedule
signature: def daily_schedule(store: Store, day: date, tz: str) -> list[str]
spec: Return one line per 'booked' booking on that local calendar day, sorted by start time, formatted exactly like '9:00 AM  Biscuit (Golden Retriever) - Dana' (local time with no leading zero on the hour, two spaces, pet name, breed in parentheses, ' - ', customer name). Skip cancelled bookings. Return an empty list if there are none.
